thread:
maria: Need landing copy that ties to launch posts, webinar, and inbound routing. Copy freeze EOD Mon. Who owns hero + CTAs + forms?
alex: I9ll own hero + CTA variants; will deliver three tight hero lines + subcopy by tomorrow AM.
sam: I9ll write webinar benchmark blurb + two customer vignettes. @alex please export p50 latency and tokens/sec.
jordan: Routing: 1) Hosted trial (light form) 2) Dedicated (sales intake) 3) Private (enterprise intake). Add hidden fields product_mode & campaign_source.
kevin: Hero families to consider: performance, economics, reliability. Keep family unified; change subcopy per mode.
maria: Deliverable: final hero, single supporting paragraph, 3 bullets (tech diffs), CTA mapping, microcopy for top form. Developer-forward.
alex: Draft copy: Hosted hero: "Instant API to ship LLM features"; sub: "SDKs, streaming, predictable per-token pricing." CTA: "Start free trial" -> /signup?utm=hosted
Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput"; sub: "SLA-backed capacity, configurable autoscaling." CTA: "Request capacity quote" -> /sales/dedicated
Private hero: "Run inference in your VPC or on-prem"; sub: "KMS/HSM, audit logs, compliance-ready." CTA: "Contact enterprise" -> /enterprise/contact
sam: Webinar blurb: "On representative chat workloads median token latency ~30ms; batching + KV cache gave ~2.5x throughput. Customers saw 30-40% inference cost reduction with cache + quantization." Mini-cases: "Acme.ai: 42% cost cut; HyperShop: 28% reduction in 95th tail after KV tuning." Slides incoming.
jordan: Form fields: Hosted: email, company (opt), use_case. Dedicated: company, expected_rps, region, phone -> SDR queue. Private: company, security_contact, compliance_needs, nda_needed -> AE+legal. Hidden fields: product_mode, campaign_source, utm_content.
kevin: A/B plan: cohorts = webinar_attendees / organic_search / paid_social. Test 3 hero variants for 14 days. Primary metric: trial starts; secondary: MQLs.
maria: Analytics events: hero_impression, cta_click, form_submit, trial_provisioned. Microcopy: "We respect your privacy. Trial access in <24h."
alex: I9ll deliver annotated mockup + copy doc + UTM schema by 10:30AM tomorrow.
ops-bot: Event created: "Landing copy review + webinar alignment" Tue 14:00 UTC. Link: https://cal.example.com/6187669999
maria: Bring assets to review: sam (slides), jordan (forms + routing), alex (mockups), kevin (A/B cohorts). :thumbsup:
